releases.name: CVar Atlas 0.3.0
releases.notes:
**Download `CVarAtlas-0.3.0.zip` below** (not "Source code").

1. Close the game.
2. Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
3. Start the game and type `/cvaratlas`.

Captures every console variable and command the client has registered (help, defaults, flags) into its SavedVariables file after `/reload` or logout.

First release on GitHub.
